remove-dead-outputs.description: Remove usages of outputs removed in this version that had already stopped firing: Overlay's onAnimationStart/onAnimationDone (and OverlayOptions config callbacks), and MenubarSub's menuFocus/menuBlur/menuKeydown.

styleclass-to-class.description: Rewrite styleClass/[styleClass] to class/[class] on selectors whose styleClass input was removed in this version in favor of the native class attribute: p-toast, p-message, p-tag, p-skeleton, p-card, p-radiobutton/p-radioButton/p-radio-button, p-progressbar/p-progressBar/p-progress-bar, p-divider, p-progressspinner/p-progressSpinner/p-progress-spinner, p-timeline, p-toolbar, p-avatar, p-chip, p-inputgroup/p-inputGroup/p-input-group, p-iconfield/p-iconField/p-icon-field, p-inputicon/p-inputIcon/p-input-icon, p-toggleswitch/p-toggleSwitch/p-toggle-switch and p-colorpicker/p-colorPicker/p-color-picker.

remove-dead-inputs.description: Remove usages of inputs removed in this version that had already stopped doing anything: p-toast/p-toastItem's showTransformOptions, hideTransformOptions, showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions; p-message's showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions; p-overlay's showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions; p-colorpicker/p-colorPicker/p-color-picker's showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions; the deprecated size of p-overlaybadge/p-overlayBadge/p-overlay-badge (use badgeSize); and the deprecated transitionOptions of p-fieldset (use motionOptions).

config-overlay-options-signal.description: Rewrite programmatic access to Exhaustive.overlayOptions, which is a signal in this version: assignments become .set(value) and reads become () calls.
